title: Towards Understanding Gender-Seniority Compound Bias in Natural Language Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating GPT-2 perplexity on a distantly-supervised dataset using counterfactual name, pronoun, and seniority-title substitutions, and measuring the frequency of gendered language in generated text across prompts with varying seniority modifiers.

Flipping gendered names and pronouns in sentences about professionals (U.S. Senators and Computer Science Professors) to calculate the difference in GPT-2 perplexity, and comparing generated text gender ratios to real-world ground truth distributions.

Substituting seniority terms (e.g., junior/senior, assistant/associate) in factual sentences to evaluate the impact on the language model's perplexity and its propensity to associate different ranks with specific genders.
